description:
Become a curious cat with a clear mission: knock over everything in sight. Navigate the house and smash 192 different household items as quickly as possible.

Explore a variety of low-poly rooms. Jump onto countertops, climb bookshelves, swipe at fragile decor, and cause absolute disaster. Keep an eye on the timer, hunt down every breakable item, and prove that nothing is safe when a cat is in the house.

Experience the world from the ground up with an immersive first-person perspective and watch your own paws swipe at targets. Search for unique breakable objects in various environments, such as a cozy study, a fully stocked bathroom, and a festive living room decorated with holiday gifts. You can even shout your triumphs on command as you race against the clock to finish your destructive spree.
